hypothesis: The native layer-16 read contains a large claim-specific component and a smaller version-specific component. Fit the mean and signed half-difference of the two early reads to the mean and signed half-difference of the two one-hot labels with separate fixed ridge scales. Recombine them to score the new edition. Swapping the two inputs swaps the two predictions. The old label is unavailable.
